name: Rilli Greasygob
summary: This quest sends an adventurer carrying a damaged samophlange from the tinkering tinker Wenikee Boltbucket directly to Orgrimmar. Seeking a specialist who truly understands the device's origins, Wenikee directs you to Rilli Greasygob, a former Venture Company engineer stationed in Nogg's Machine Shop.

sections.title: When Tinkering Fails
sections.body: Wenikee Boltbucket tried her hand at diagnosing the samophlange recovered from the Venture Company drilling site in the Barrens. Unfortunately, adding extra gauges only confirmed that the apparatus was on the verge of total collapse. Recognizing that piling on more levers and dials might destroy the device entirely, Boltbucket admitted defeat and decided to refer the problem to someone with proprietary expertise.

sections.title: A Former Company Man
sections.body: To decipher the inner workings of the contraption, Boltbucket sends travelers into Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor to visit Nogg's Machine Shop. There works Rilli Greasygob, an engineer who once earned his trade within the cutthroat ranks of the Venture Company. Greasygob instantly recognizes the machine, marveling that anyone survived poking around the cartel's contested operations in the Barrens.

faq.answer: Rilli Greasygob is a goblin engineer working out of Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Having previously worked for the Venture Company, he possesses rare firsthand knowledge of the cartel's proprietary technology, including mysterious devices like the samophlange.

faq.q: Why couldn't Wenikee Boltbucket fix the samophlange herself?
faq.answer: Wenikee Boltbucket attempted to diagnose the samophlange by attaching extra gauges, but they revealed its structural integrity was rapidly deteriorating. Realizing that haphazard tinkering would only ruin the delicate apparatus, she decided it needed someone with direct Venture Company manufacturing experience.
Rilli Greasygob is located inside Nogg's Machine Shop in the Valley of Honor, situated in the northeastern district of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company's role in this?
faq.answer: The samophlange was recovered from the Venture Company's strip-mining operation at the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens. Because it is custom Venture Company technology, former company personnel like Rilli Greasygob are the only ones capable of properly servicing and interpreting it.

faq.q: What happens after giving the samophlange to Rilli?
faq.answer: Recognizing the device, Rilli Greasygob determines that to fully operate or reconstruct it, he will require the Venture Company's official operational instructions, leading adventurers to recover the Samophlange Manual.

Nobody involved seems quite sure. It is an intricate, bizarre Venture Company device full of gears; even Wenikee Boltbucket had to ask what a samophlange was, and Rilli needs the company's own manual to make sense of it.

angles.text: Every engineer knows when to put down the wrench; Boltbucket's realization that more dials would only make matters worse leads straight to specialized trade secrets preserved by former corporate technicians.
The Horde relies on urban workshops like Nogg's in Orgrimmar to repurpose enemy machinery captured from predatory syndicates exploiting Kalimdor.
